description: This file defines the SqlAttributesStore struct and its methods for managing attribute data in a Mattermost server, including querying, refreshing views, and searching users and channel members based on attributes.

classes.name: SqlAttributesStore
classes.description: Struct for managing attribute data, including querying and updating attribute views.

methods.name: attributesSliceColumns
methods.description: Generates column list for attribute slices, with optional prefix.

methods.name: newSqlAttributesStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SqlAttributesStore instance.

methods.name: RefreshAttributes
methods.description: Refreshes the materialized view for attributes.

methods.name: GetSubject
methods.description: Retrieves a subject's attributes based on ID and groupID.

methods.name: SearchUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on various criteria and search options.

methods.name: GetChannelMembersToRemove
methods.description: Retrieves channel members to be removed based on search options.
